questions.question: Where was David when he wrote Psalm 63?
options: In the courts of the temple
In the caves near the Dead Sea

questions.question: How does David describe his desire for God?
options: His mouth sings and his lips rejoice in the LORD
His soul thirsts and his flesh faints for God as in a dry land
His eyes weep and his hands tremble before God
His heart trembles and his very bones ache with fear of the LORD
questions.answer: His soul thirsts and his flesh faints for God as in a dry land

questions.question: David says God's steadfast love is better than life.
O God, you are my God; earnestly I _____ you.
My soul will be satisfied as with fat and rich food, and my mouth will praise you with joyful _____.
